info.title: DevPilot Local API
info.description: Local secured API/UI shell for DevPilot visual dashboard, report/trace viewers, Approval Center, Settings UI and security posture diagnostics. POST-H-014-E quality-gated implementation.

get.description: Return registered-workspace portfolio status without changing active workspace.

Return a redacted local API/UI security posture diagnostic.

POST-H-014-D keeps this endpoint protected by the same token and PolicyEngine
middleware as other non-public routes. It never returns the raw API token or
secret values, and it does not start services, touch the network or mutate
files.

get.description:
Return sanitized, actor-neutral Project Status and NextAction.

This endpoint is local/protected and read-only. It delegates all domain
semantics to ApplicationService -> GuidedSDLCService; no route logic reads
filesystem/Git or recomputes ProjectStatus.
Return actor-aware StepActionCards without granting target capabilities.

ApiApplicationRequest.title: ApiApplicationRequest
ApiApplicationRequest.description:
HTTP request envelope accepted by local API POST routes.

The transport remains deliberately small. Route handlers pin the operation
to the endpoint contract and do not allow a request body to switch to a
different operation.
